extracted text: The paper studies 7075Al-T651 rolled plates with a thickness of 8mm. Table 1 provides the nominal chemical composition and tensile properties of the base material. The study focuses on friction stir welding of this alloy and examines the effect of initial butt surface on tensile properties and fracture behavior. Post-weld T6-treatment (PW-T6) was also conducted, which involved solutionizing at 470°C for 1h, water quenching, and then aging at 120°C for 24h.
